_note: The input side of stage 5's tests: scored passages and the judgement that arrived with them, grouped into one named set per rule the aggregator has to apply. Every outlet, URL, figure, quotation and rating here is invented, like everything else under tests/fixtures/ — none of it may be presented as real reporting. Nothing in this file is fetched: stage 5 makes no network call and no model call at all, so these are simply the values retrieve/stance/judge would have handed it. Each entry carries the Passage fields plus the two ScoredPassage fields (stance, rationale_quote); every cited_span in a judgement is an exact substring of one of its set's passages unless the set's name says otherwise.
